nodes.label: Task-oriented Today queues
nodes.rationale: 5. P2: Staff and owners need different default emphasis. Staff need actionable queues; owners need bottlenecks, shipment readiness and outstanding money. New assignment or due-date functionality would require data/model support; do not imply it already exists. Proposed navigation: Today; Orders; Purchasing; Packing; Billing for authorized users; Administration for owners. Keep Scan box readily accessible as a utility. Each section opens its queue; selected records open a workspace. Preserve search, filters and scroll on return. Use record context and breadcrumbs separately from the business-stage tracker.

nodes.label: Packing task strip
nodes.rationale: Reusable task strip example (illustrative data): Order AGR-1042 / customer / shipment date / route. Packing: 8 of 10 boxes weighed. Next: enter weights for boxes 9 and 10. Primary action: Enter remaining weights. Once saved: Review and finalize packing. After finalization: Sent to accounting; Pack next order. Show actual progress and blockers from authoritative workflow state rather than fixed screen order. Cognitive load: packing and procurement combine selection, export, editing, progress and submission controls. nodes.label: Packing-floor usability validation
nodes.rationale: Persona red flags: new staff can mistake a workflow link for an allowed action; buying staff must re-find their batch's orders after confirmation; packing staff need outstanding-box focus and interrupted-work recovery; owners need exceptions prioritized over total counts. Mobile usability remains unverified and needs a packing-floor walkthrough. Detector: six warnings across two files: five side-tab accent-border warnings at web/app/globals.css:333,1031,1270,1286,1346; one layout-transition warning at web/app/procurement/page.tsx:624.
